title: I've just released the demo for my first horror game on Steam!
author: Many-Yesterday3768
selftext:
So this is the first thing I've ever put out for real people to play, and I'm kind of terrified, which fits I guess.

You don't get a weapon (yet) and you don't get a health bar. You get a dark house, a flashlight, and a few things walking around that you learn to tell apart by sound.

The demo covers the first act and takes most people around 20 - 30 minutes.

AI disclosure: voices are from ElevenLabs; models, animation, levels and code are mine.

demo : [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5309090/TwoFifteen](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5309090/TwoFifteen)
